games.name: 1984 Utopia
games.desc:
Experience a blend of DarkRP and “Become Leader" genres, with 13 roles to play!

V2: WHAT’S NEW?
A total game renovation with a ton of NEW features:
- BASE-BUILDING
- MASSIVE OPTIMISATION, greatly improved FPS
- Innovative “interactable” props system
- New Vehicle System 
- New Crafting System
- https://devforum.roblox.com/t/1984-game-overhaul-sep-25-update/4893184

PC Controls:
B - Build Mode
C - Toggle Combat
G - Open Inventory
H - Drop Item
N - Emotes
T - Open Overview

GAMEPLAY:
- As a Wastelander, enjoy a “peaceful” life in the city… or go out in the hot waste, some rebuild society there.
- Build a shop, a hospital, start your own bank, a restaurant, a farm, even a fort!
- Tired of adventure? Join the State! Become Police to enforce laws and confiscate money printers, a Thought Agent to hunt traitors, or even a Minister to help run the state!
- As the Leader, run the nation; enact policies, maintain authority, appoint officials - while dealing with unhappy rebels!

games.name: An Infinite Highway
games.desc:
Journey across the continent in an expedition group whose goal is to survey and explore dangerous territory.

You will ride from pole-to-pole, crossing through various biomes, whether it be:
--Tropical savannas teeming with wildlife
--Dry deserts, baked by the hot scorching sun
--Valleys with goats and cattle in between the tall mountains
--Cold, icey polar regions, where the sun dances around

Becareful however, as bandits fill the area, raiding settlements, disrupting trade routes, and waging conflict with government forces.
